function [Ad,Bd,Cd,Dd] = dv_coefficients_Tustin(smoke_T)
%dv_coefficients_Tustin
%    [Ad,Bd,Cd,Dd] = dv_coefficients_Tustin(smoke_T)

%    This function was generated by the Symbolic Math Toolbox version 26.1.
%    2026-09-10 22:40:48

t2 = smoke_T+2.0;
t3 = 1.0./t2;
t4 = t3.*2.0;
t5 = t3.*4.0;
Ad = t5-1.0;
if nargout > 1
    Bd = -t5+2.0;
end
if nargout > 2
    Cd = t4;
end
if nargout > 3
    Dd = -t4+1.0;
end
end
